title: Mergent has a new YC Deal
summary: Y Combinator founders: We've launched an exclusive YC deal for the W24 batch and all YC alumni-founded companies. Details of the deal are available in Bookface. Ready to get started? Email us at yc@mergent.co.
body_markdown:
